# Hexworth Prime

> An AI-native cybersecurity and technology education platform organized into 12 themed "houses," with hands-on labs, CTF challenges, certification-aligned courses, and integrated career development.

Hexworth Prime teaches cybersecurity, AI, Linux, networking, cloud, and programming through interactive, browser-based modules, immersive labs, CTF boxes, and server-graded assessments. It integrates learning, hands-on practice, and career preparation in a single connected platform. All content is browser-based with no install required.

## Key pages

- [About](https://hexworth.com/about.html): Platform overview, security, authentication, and data handling
- [Product Overview](https://hexworth.com/product-info.html): What the platform includes
- [FAQ](https://hexworth.com/faq.html): Common questions about the platform
- [Career Launchpad](https://hexworth.com/career/): Career pathways, resume tools, interview prep, and job board
- [Image Gallery](https://hexworth.com/gallery.html): Public brand and course artwork
- [Sitemap](https://hexworth.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable pages

## About

- [The 12 Houses](https://hexworth.com/sorting.html): Themed learning domains spanning security, AI, cloud, networking, forensics, hardware, and more
- Learning model: AI-assisted instruction, hands-on labs, CTF challenges, and certification prep aligned to real industry roles
